textos.O filme apresenta uma sucessão de elemen: The film presents a succession of disconnected, overlapping elements that tire more than they engage, and the attempt to justify this mess as part of the aesthetic proposal is not convincing; the lack of a clear narrative and the amount of visual stimuli make the experience exhausting and hinder comprehension.
textos.A história tenta abordar a relação entre: The story tries to address the mother-daughter relationship, generational trauma and the importance of family through a multiversal allegory, but these ideas are presented superficially and resolved abruptly and in a clichéd way, without psychological depth.
textos.As piadas envolvendo elementos escatológ: The jokes involving scatological, sexual and absurd elements feel forced and out of place, breaking the mood of moments that could have been serious and adding to a sense of embarrassment and pointlessness.
textos.Apesar da montagem frenética, o longa se: Despite the frenetic editing, the film drags, especially in the final third, repeating the same ideas and slow-motion scenes that add neither tension nor emotion; what should be dynamic ends up tedious and tiring.
textos.A conclusão tenta entregar uma moral sob: The conclusion tries to deliver a moral about love, acceptance and the infinity of possibilities, but it sounds empty and generic, with no support in the plot; the reflection on nihilism and humanism is presented as slogans, not as something genuinely explored.
textos.A aclamação crítica e a vitória no Oscar: The critical acclaim and the Oscar win seem disproportionate to the quality of the film, which delivers more of an appearance of depth than real substance; aspects such as the editing are praised, but the whole does not justify the recognition.
textos.A narrativa tenta abraçar tantas ideias: The narrative tries to embrace so many ideas and absurdities that it ends up tiring, with several reviews noting that the film runs longer than necessary and that the pacing swings between dragging moments and sensory overload.
textos.Muitos destacam a direção inventiva, a e: Many highlight the inventive direction, the agile editing, the creative cinematography and the impressive production design, acknowledging the technical effort behind the experience.
textos.Humor não funciona para todos: The humor doesn't work for everyone
textos.O tom cômico, repleto de referências e e: The comic tone, full of references and scatological humor, divides opinions: some find it fun, but many consider the humor forced, dated or something that undercuts the seriousness of the dramatic scenes.
textos.A tentativa de misturar ação maluca com: The attempt to mix crazy action with family drama ends up sounding disconnected, with the emotional core overshadowed by the excess of jokes and twists, leaving the impact reduced.
textos.A performance da protagonista é amplamen: The lead's performance is widely praised as the high point, with a charisma and depth that hold the film together even when the plot loses focus.
textos.A reflexão sobre sentido da vida, escolh: The reflection on the meaning of life, choices and human connections is noted, but many consider the approach unoriginal or too didactically laid out, sounding moralistic.
textos.Caos e absurdo como experiência: Chaos and absurdity as an experience
textos.O filme é uma montanha-russa de situaçõe: The film is a roller coaster of bizarre situations with no apparent sense, which in the end turn out to be part of a unique and unforgettable experience.
textos.A obra aborda o conflito entre mãe e fil: The work addresses the conflict between mother and daughter, generational trauma and the search for acceptance within the dynamics of an Asian immigrant family.
textos.O longa discute o niilismo, a infinitude: The film discusses nihilism and the infinity of possibilities and teaches that, even amid chaos, it is possible to find beauty and purpose in the life one has.
textos.O elenco, com destaque para os quatro pr: The cast, especially the four leads, delivers striking performances that elevate the narrative even further.
textos.A edição dinâmica e as escolhas visuais: The dynamic editing and innovative visual choices, with impressive fight choreography and references to several genres, make the film a spectacle.
textos.A obra apresenta uma proposta tão origin: The work presents a proposal so original that it defies any comparison, mixing elements of science fiction, comedy and drama in a way never seen before.

textos.Lançado em 2022 e dirigido por Daniel Sc: Released in 2022 and directed by Daniel Scheinert, Everything Everywhere All at Once is a feature film that blends action, adventure and science fiction across its 139 minutes. In the official premise, a Chinese immigrant sets off on an adventure in which, alone, she must save the world while exploring multiple universes and alternate paths she could have lived, but finds herself in trouble when she becomes stuck in this infinity of possibilities without finding the way back home.
textos.A experiência de acompanhar a obra é car: The experience of watching the work is characterized by a fast pace and a constant aesthetic density, built on dynamic editing and a continuous alternation between the intensity of the absurd, eccentric comedy and a personal-drama tone.
textos.Na grande maioria das notas (~86%), uma: In the vast majority of ratings (~86%), a significant share sees chaos and absurdity as central elements of a striking, singular experience. In addition, many emphasize the strength of the themes of family dynamics, trauma and the search for acceptance, while a good portion highlights the relevance of the existential message and the feeling of hope built by the narrative.
textos.Para quem se posiciona numa fração mínim: For those who fall within a minimal fraction of the ratings (~9%), several maintain that the excess of events and the overload of stimuli make the journey tiring, even though a considerable number recognize and praise the film's technical qualities and inventive visuals. In addition, a significant share of this segment judges that the humor does not work uniformly for everyone.
textos.Por fim, na perspectiva de quem integra: Finally, from the perspective of those who make up an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~5%), many point out that the execution results in excessive, confusing chaos. In this context, a good portion considers the family metaphor forced and poorly developed, while a portion reject the comic tone as bizarre and unfunny.
